title: Boeing F-15EX St. Louis production line: Phase 56F Coverage Decision
summary: The FY 2027 procurement exhibits supply planned quantities and delivery windows for later lots. Phase 56F decision: The official planned-input and delivery-window record is closed; realized post-restart monthly acceptance and line performance are not.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Monthly planned and accepted deliveries after the 2025 restart.
Remaining gap: Monthly planned and accepted deliveries, labor, rework, yield, supplier constraints, cost, and quality findings.
why_it_matters: The coverage decision prevents broad context from displacing the one operating or closure record that would materially deepen the named entity.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the stable entity ID manufacturer-boeing-f15ex-st-louis.
Separates current evidence from the missing record.
Names the exact condition that can reopen the decision.
evidence_limits: Budget quantities and planned delivery dates are not monthly accepted output, line throughput, labor, rework, yield, cost performance, or realized schedule.
Monthly planned and accepted deliveries, labor, rework, yield, supplier constraints, cost, and quality findings.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
